portrait.note: The saved file matches the large avatar on her live Kaggle profile: a dark-and-white upright-eared rabbit above a gray lop-eared rabbit, same pose and framing. It is her own chosen profile picture (not a group of people, not a default avatar). It is a pet picture, not a photo of her face, and no other public photo of her was found. The live image is storage.googleapis.com/kaggle-avatars/images/12752459-kg.jpeg (version stamp 2026-10-01); it was compared by eye and not downloaded. The AI editorial version (yi-chia-chen-editorial-v1.webp) is a separate artwork made from this avatar.

facts.text: Yi-Chia Chen is a Kaggle Competitions Master, ranked 335th of 225,021 with a highest-ever rank of 75th, and her account dates from December 2022.
Her Kaggle profile shows nine competition medals: one gold, five silver and three bronze.
